emerging_technology: Large language models (generative AI for text)
intended_application: Ambient clinical documentation: drafting visit notes from recorded doctor-patient conversations for physician review
organization: Venture-funded telehealth startup offering virtual primary care (~40 clinicians)
business_need: Increase clinician visit capacity and keep documentation costs low to support growth
users_stakeholders: Remote clinicians, patients, product/engineering team, compliance lead, investors
capabilities_constraints: Strong in-house engineering; custom EHR; all visits already recorded on video; lean compliance function
risk_consequence_context: High clinical and privacy consequences (same as any care provider), but faster ability to iterate and roll back
management_question: Should the company build LLM note drafting into its platform for all clinicians?
